Venus.1: Venus in its own place gives the destruction of one's wealth and wisdom
Venus.2: in the second strife with one's wife
Venus.3: in the third it destroys honor, wealth, and brilliance
Venus.4: in the fourth it gives honor from one's own relatives and expensive things
Venus.5: in the fifth it causes injuries and wandering and destroys one's wealth
Venus.6: in the sixth it produces intelligence, beauty, and honor
Venus.7: in the seventh sexual intercourse with women and food
Venus.8: in the eighth Venus causes distress from low people
Venus.9: in the ninth it destroys cleanliness and sexual intercourse and gives wandering
Venus.10: in the tenth it destroys pleasure and profits from one's actions
Venus.11: in the eleventh Venus produces women, silver, and food
Venus.12: and in the twelfth joy and beauty

Sun.1: Venus in the place of the Sun gives little happiness and anguish
Sun.2: in the second it causes excessive expenditures
Sun.3: in the third (it produces) quarrels with one's sons and wife and fear
Sun.4: and in the fourth goading and piercing by one's enemies
Sun.5: in the fifth it gives loss of wealth, wandering, and disease
Sun.6: in the sixth Venus destroys joy, happiness, and money
Sun.7: in the seventh it causes strife with one's wife and breaking
Sun.8: in the eighth pleasure and good health
Sun.9: in the ninth Venus causes the appearance of wounds and roaming
Sun.10: in the tenth the loss of one's money
Sun.11: in the eleventh Venus gives the acquisition of gold
Sun.12: and in the twelfth cleanliness and food

Saturn.1: Venus in the place of Saturn gives strife, hunger, and quarrels
Saturn.3: in the third it causes the acquisition of cows, buffaloes, and money
Saturn.4: in the fourth success with regard to friends and wealth
Saturn.5: in the fifth Venus causes the acquisition of position, wealth, and money
Saturn.6: in the sixth the appearance of pride, fatigue, and illness
Saturn.7: in the seventh diseases of the genitals
Saturn.8: in the eighth the acquisition of position, glory, and happiness
Saturn.9: in the ninth Venus causes the acquisition of women and property
Saturn.10: in the tenth the appearance of honor and happiness
Saturn.11: in the eleventh the acquisition of women, extravagant things, and money

Jupiter.1: Venus in the place of Jupiter takes away beauty, intellect, and exercise
Jupiter.2: in the second it causes destruction
Jupiter.3: in the third expenditure of one's money and quarrels
Jupiter.4: in the fourth indigestion and an increase of phlegm
Jupiter.5: in the fifth the acquisition of sons, status, and real estate
Jupiter.6: in the sixth it gives diseases and fear
Jupiter.7: in the seventh Venus produces knowledge
Jupiter.8: in the eighth position, women, and good health
Jupiter.9: in the ninth it gives success with regard to speech and money
Jupiter.10: in the tenth honor and wealth from great men
Jupiter.11: in the eleventh it causes an increase in one's treasure
Jupiter.12: and in the twelfth Venus gives the loss of one's business and pleasure

Mars.1: Venus in the place of Mars causes offenses and the death of one's wife
Mars.3: in the third many possessions, honor, and enjoyment
Mars.4: in the fourth it gives valor
Mars.5: in the fifth it produces power, courage, and diligence
Mars.6: in the sixth (it gives) beauty and nobility
Mars.7: in the seventh Venus destroys one's wife, one's happiness, and one's prosperity
Mars.8: in the eighth it causes decline and evil
Mars.9: in the ninth Venus (gives) success in arguments and a good wife
Mars.10: in the tenth the loss of one's accumulated possessions
Mars.11: in the eleventh the acquisition of lands, gold, and sons

Mercury.1: Venus in the place of Mercury destroys one's virility and beauty
Mercury.3: in the third it destroys diseases and one's foes
Mercury.4: in the fourth it takes away honor and victory
Mercury.5: in the fifth (the native) is a leader in sons, clothes, position, and wealth
Mercury.6: in the sixth it gives victory
Mercury.7: in the seventh it destroys one's business and power
Mercury.8: in the eighth it obstructs one's intelligence and strength
Mercury.9: in the ninth it causes worship from men who rise from their seats (to pay their respects), learning, and honor
Mercury.10: in the tenth it destroys one's vows
Mercury.11: in the eleventh Venus gives lands, sons, and money
Mercury.12: and in the twelfth it hinders one's business

Moon.1: Venus in the place of the Moon causes the acquisition of gold, women, silver, money, learning, sons, clothes, position, and quadrupeds
Moon.2: in the second the gaining of wealth and a wife
Moon.3: in the third it produces cows, lands, garments, sons, honor, joy, position, women, and good health
Moon.4: in the fourth Venus gives wealth, a wife, sons, friends, good food, clothes, and perfume
Moon.5: in the fifth it gives friends, the birth of sons, the appearance of good qualities, fame, and money
Moon.6: in the sixth Venus causes poverty, quarrels, diseases, hatred, and the loss of one's honor
Moon.7: in the seventh Venus gives debts, wandering, anxiety caused by women, and bad friends
Moon.8: in the eighth women, happiness, publicity, honor, joy, friends, learning, and clothes
Moon.9: in the ninth Venus causes the acquisition of wealth from friends, elders (guru), and women, of righteousness ( dharma), of knowledge, of glory, and of good qualities
Moon.10: in the tenth the loss of one's money, the affection of one's relatives, the profits of one's actions, and one's honor
Moon.11: in the eleventh it produces women, beds, food, drink, ornaments, sexual intercourse, joy, houses, and money
Moon.12: and in the twelfth Venus gives food and happiness, and causes the loss of one's clothes

Ascendant.1: Venus in the ascendent produces an abundance of cows, friends, jewels, clothes, gold, women, edible foods, beds, precious stones, and pearls
Ascendant.2: in the second place it gives a wife, wealth, and grain
Ascendant.3: in the third Venus gives the acquisition of gold and pearls, and causes the destruction of one's enemies
Ascendant.4: in the fourth it gives cows, houses, ornaments, women, prosperity, and honor from one's relatives and friends
Ascendant.5: in the fifth from the ascendent it causes the acquisition and attainment of wealth, honor, a wife, business, and glory
Ascendant.6: in the sixth Venus produces many quarrels, wanderings, griefs, toils, injuries, and pains
Ascendant.7: in the seventh quarrels with one's wife, diseases, and sorrows originating in the deceits of women
Ascendant.8: in the eighth Venus gives various foods, drinks, friends, sciences, and ornaments
Ascendant.9: in the ninth Venus gives reverence, wealth, and honor from the lords (isvara)
Ascendant.10: in the tenth Venus produces little livelihood, the aversion of outstanding men, diseases, and illness
Ascendant.11: in the eleventh Venus gives precious stones, jewels, pearls, women, ornaments, clothes, and food
Ascendant.12: and in the twelfth place from the ascendent it causes the loss of one's wealth, wandering, and mental delusion
